name: &fFarm Merchant
greeting: Fresh from the fields this morning!
Seeds, crops, a hoe if you need one. Have a look.

name: &fMine Merchant
greeting: Heading down the coal mine? You'll want a proper pick.
I'll buy back whatever you dig up, too.

name: &fLumber Merchant
greeting: Every log in this town passed through my hands.
Axes, logs, the odd wooden tool. Take your pick.

name: &fFish Merchant
greeting: The pond's been generous today.
A rod, some bait and a full angler's kit, all here.

name: &fWeaponsmith
greeting: Every blade on this rack has seen a graveyard or two.
Pick one that fits your hand.

name: &fArmorsmith Brenna
greeting: Brenna's the name, plate is the game.
From plain iron to sets fit for a knight - I hammered them all.

name: &fAdventurer
greeting: I've cleared every crypt from here to the ruins.
Mob drops and a few lucky charms - interested?

name: &fBuilder
greeting: An island is only as good as what you build on it.
Stone, wood, glass, colour - I stock the lot.

name: &fBartender
greeting: What'll it be? Coffee keeps the slayers going.
Ask about the stronger stuff if you've the coin.

name: &fLibrarian
greeting: Shh - this is a library.
Bottles of experience and starter books, quietly sold.

name: &fAlchemist
greeting: Careful with that bottle, it's still bubbling.
Ingredients for every brew you can name.

name: &fFletcher Quill
greeting: Arrows, fletched by hand.
Bring me enchanted materials and I'll tip them with something nasty.
where: the archery range by the weaponsmith

name: &fGravedigger Sexby
greeting: Digging graves turns up a lot of gravel.
And gravel turns up flint. Want some?

name: &fBeekeeper Honora
greeting: Mind the hive - they're friendly once they know you.
I'll even part with a bee of your own.
where: the village, near the flower house

name: &fCritter Merchant Wex
greeting: Treats, claws, teeth - everything a pet could want.
They gain levels faster with the right item.

name: &fMarlo the Aquarist
greeting: My seals love fishy treats.
Bring me treats and I'll trade you something special.

name: &fTailor Fennimore
greeting: Only the finest suits leave my shop.
Fine tailoring has never been cheap.
where: a fashion shop in the village

name: &fBroker Vell
greeting: Stocks for treasures, treasures for stocks.
A sharp trader always has a few shares to spend.
where: near the bank or the auction house

name: &fShady Malloy
greeting: Psst. Shops overcharge, everybody knows it.
Wear one of my rings and they'll knock a little off.
where: the wilderness, near the dark auction

name: &fHedgewitch Morra
greeting: Bring me the odd things monsters leave behind.
I brew them into charms. Mostly harmless ones.
where: a crooked hut in the village

name: &fDialer Pim
greeting: Stay in touch with the whole island!

name: &fDecorator Lune
greeting: Make your island a place people want to visit.
Games, displays, a parkour course or two.

name: &fOwl-keeper Whitcombe
greeting: Hoo goes there? Ah, a customer.

name: &fOld Tobias
greeting: Tired of the climb? So am I.
A scroll will take you straight to the top.
where: at the foot of the wizard tower

name: &fPensive Hermit
greeting: What is a castle without visitors?
Take a scroll, so you may return.

name: &fShoveller Brisk
greeting: Up here the snow never stops.
A good shovel makes short work of it.

name: &fPipefitter Dunn
greeting: Water where it shouldn't be? I've got just the thing.

name: &fSly Quentin
greeting: Slayers swear by my drinks.
Don't ask what's in them.
where: a back alley near the tavern

name: &fStonemonger Haldor
greeting: Reforge stones, the rare ones the Blacksmith won't stock.

name: &fTinkerer Sprocket
greeting: Levers! Repeaters! Pressure plates!
Everything you need to wire up your island.

name: &fCarpenter
greeting: Furniture built to last.
Every piece is hand-carved, right here.

name: &fWool Weaver
greeting: Sixteen colours of everything.
Wool, carpet, glass and clay - dyed fresh.

name: &fPig Shop
greeting: Oink. I mean - welcome!
Shiny shards and pig things, best prices on the island.

name: &fWindmill Operator
greeting: The mill grinds all day; I sell what it doesn't.
Same stock as the hub, no walk back.

name: &fRancher Jed
greeting: Hunting critters takes the right axe.
Bring your basic axe and I'll upgrade it.

name: &fBait-maker Wade
greeting: Chum! Glowing chum! The fish go wild for it.

name: &fSurveyor Pruitt
greeting: Pelts are the currency out here.
Trap enough and I'll make it worth your while.

name: &fFur-trader Alder
greeting: I upgrade minions. I take pelts. Simple.

name: &fMerry Norseman
greeting: Hah! Another wanderer in the woods!
My axes split trunks and skulls alike.

name: &fStrategist Varro
greeting: Every battle is won before it starts.
The right sword helps, of course.

name: &fElder Shaman Oku
greeting: The forest speaks to those who listen.
I sell its essence, for a price.

name: &fGold Forger
greeting: Gold, gold and more gold!
Forged it all myself, down here in the heat.

name: &fIron Forger
greeting: My brother does gold. I do iron. Better metal.

name: &fBlaster Wim
greeting: Stand back! Further! Further!

name: &fLamplighter Luminelle
greeting: The mines are dark, but they needn't be.

name: &fPickwright Dobb
greeting: Broken pickaxe? I can mend it into something better.

name: &fForeman Bolgar
greeting: Your minions could work harder. I can make them.

name: &fGrubmaster Tuck
greeting: Miners eat like dragons.
My cooking puts fortune in your stomach.

name: &fResearcher Opaline
greeting: Fossils! Under all that ice!
Bring me essence and I'll lend you my tools.

name: &fHollows Merchant
greeting: Some walls just need persuading.
Boom. Persuaded.

name: &fGemcutter Isla
greeting: A diamond is only a rock until it is cut.

name: &fTribal Elder Wahu
greeting: The sludge of the jungle is precious to my people.
Bring it, and we will trade.

name: &fCrystal Mender Thorne
greeting: The altar answers only to a crystal.
Bring fragments and I'll shape one.

name: &fSpider Tamer
greeting: They only bite when they're hungry. Usually.

name: &fArcher Peregrine
greeting: Endermen hate arrows. That's why I sell them.

name: &fPearl Dealer
greeting: Pearls, eyes and the odd rare book.
The void is generous to those who pay.

name: &fDesert Peddler Kesh
greeting: Red sand, blaze rods, everything a brewer needs.

name: &fMushroom Peddler Vos
greeting: Mycelium and nether goods, fresh off the fields.

name: &fBrewmaster Calder
greeting: A warm drink against the cold of the void.

name: &fBrewer Gruk
greeting: Drink up! Barbarians don't do small cups.

name: &fForgewife Hessa
greeting: Nether minions need nether upgrades.

name: &fForgemaster Marrok
greeting: My hammer makes minions work through the night.

name: &fLampwright Sabine
greeting: A lamp in every colour of the rainbow - and the rainbow too.

name: &fTrophy Keeper Ogden
greeting: Every trophy fish tells a story.
Prove your skill and gear up like a true hunter.

name: &fPhone Dealer Ude
greeting: Latest models, straight from the factory!

name: &fFrantic Engineer
greeting: Please, buy it! I need the coins to fix my machine!

name: &fDevotee Draven
greeting: The great beast below rewards its followers.

name: &fMage Envoy
greeting: The mages of the isle extend their welcome.

entries.note: research 04 §4.3: 200,000 (neu snapshot 7,600; 4 keys craft a Hot Key)

name: &fBarbarian Envoy
greeting: The barbarians trade with the strong.

name: &fScrapper Nettle
greeting: One fisher's junk is another fisher's treasure.
Rusty coins welcome.

name: &fStargazer Eino
greeting: Every gift opened during the season brings a star.
Collect them - I trade generously.

name: &fFrost Vendor Sela
greeting: Ice, bait and festive treats!

name: &fIce Carver Tarn
greeting: Hunks of ice carve into lovely trinkets.

name: &fFrostbitten Aleks
greeting: S-s-so c-cold... b-buy something?

name: &fQuartermistress Odile
greeting: Heading into the catacombs? Don't go empty-handed.

name: &fEssence Broker Sameer
greeting: Essence buys what coins cannot.
